nom: SKIN1004 Lab in Nature Centella Retinol 0.2 Boosting Shot Ampoule

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers largely tolerated the retinol well with mild or no tingling and no significant irritation, though one non-sensitive user still experienced a wrecked barrier and one sensitive reviewer flagged that wet skin or dry climates raise the risk of irritation.
segments.dry: One reviewer with a drier climate noted the product should be paired with barrier-strengthening products, and several others reported no dryness or flaking despite retinol use.
segments.mature: Reviewers using it in an anti-aging routine reported softer fine lines, smaller-looking pores, and firmer, more even-looking skin after a few weeks to a month.
segments.combination: No dedicated combination-skin commentary beyond general oil-free, non-greasy absorption reported across reviewers.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, smaller pores, and firmer or more refined skin within a month of consistent use; one reviewer with deeper lines noted less dramatic results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as hydrating or non-drying, with skin feeling soft and smooth after use; however, one reviewer reported dry patches and barrier damage and another noted initial dryness and irritation before adjusting frequency.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report no redness or irritation even as retinol beginners; one reviewer specifically experienced redness and irritation without seeing benefits.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes serious barrier damage (stinging with other products, dryness) that resolved after stopping use; most others report no barrier issues and highlight the calming effect of centella.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faded dark spots and post-acne marks with regular use, including one case attributed to sun-induced pigmentation clearing over a month.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts and some describe reduced or calmed acne and inflammation; one reviewer explicitly states the product broke her out.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically addresses oil control; several mention the formula absorbs without leaving a greasy residue, but this is a texture comment rather than an oiliness-concern report.

extraits.texte: I don't have sensitive skin and I can't say I react negatively to products often at all, but this one turned out to be a big problem. Dry patches all around and after about a month my regular products began to sting on application - that's what this product did to my skin barrier. Yes, I've used retinoids before and I did introduce it gradually, working my way up to a more frequent use. How do I know this is the issue? I stopped using it and 5 days later my skin was back to normal. Way too aggressive of a formula, particularly the Hydrolyzed Sponge (Spicules) "delivery method" in it that basically feels like tiny shards of glass cutting your skin when you apply it. Not to mention the dropper isn't great either. Definitely one of the worst skin care products I've ever used.

I was really excited to try the Lab in Nature Centella Retinol serum, but unfortunately it was a letdown in several ways. First, the packaging is a major design flaw. Retinol is sensitive to light, so it should be packaged in a dark or opaque bottle to help preserve its stability and effectiveness. Instead, the clear bottle makes me question how well the product maintains its potency over time. The dropper is also poorly designed. It doesn't pick up the serum well, making it frustrating and difficult to get the product out of the bottle. I found myself having to repeatedly squeeze the dropper or tilt the bottle just to get enough product for one application. As for the formula itself, it tends to pill badly, especially when layering with other skincare products or moisturizer. Even after allowing it time to absorb, it often rolled off my skin instead of blending in smoothly. To make matters worse, I didn't notice any meaningful improvement in my skin after consistent use. Instead, I experienced irritation and redness without seeing the benefits I expect from a retinol product. Between the ineffective packaging, the pilling, and the lack of results, this serum was disappointing. I won't be purchasing it again and would recommend looking at other retinol options with better packaging and formulation.

OK, so I really like this for the first couple of nights that I tried it, it made my skin feel really nice and it absorbed beautifully into my skin and it didn't dry my skin out which I loved. However, it did break me out.

I have sensitive skin so I am usually wary of retinol products but this product is so good. I started off using it for a few times a week and so far so good. I love how it leaves my skin feeling. It is definitely a great addition to my skin care routine.

Thank you to Skin1004 for giving this to me for free in exchange for my honest review. I wanna start by saying I was quite intimidated by trying this. I've tried spicules before and thought they were quite intense. So because this is paired with retinol I was extra cautious. However, I didn't feel any intense pain or even much tingling. I was completely surprised and that made me way more comfortable to keep using this. I don't have deep lines so my results might be less impressive but I do notice less fine lines. Keep in mind to only use this on dry skin, wet skin might make this too tingly and may cause irritation. I think it's also important to mention that you should be using skin barrier strengthening products if you are in a drier climate. It's definitely worth it for the results!

I've been using this retinol serum for a few weeks and have definitely noticed smoother skin and a more even texture. It absorbs well and doesn't feel heavy or greasy, which I really like. That said, it is pretty strong—my skin felt a bit dry and slightly irritated at first, so I'd recommend starting slow and using it a few times a week before building up.

I have been using this product for three weeks now. I have sensitive skin so I started out using this serum 2x per week and increased to 3x per week. My skin has never looked better it is more even and radiance and my mild acne has cleared up. I will be purchasing again!
